name: Alien Mindpaths [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
When you’re in the company of other aliens, your mind makes the thoughts of others become difficult to follow.

Prerequisite(s): Any species alien to this planet or plane.

Benefit(s): Whenever you’re adjacent to at least one other ally alien to this world, said ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus on saves against mind-affecting effects and divination (scrying) effects, unless the effect comes from an android, kasatha, lashunta, or triaxian.
